primary_definition: Firedrake official DG advection demo, selected geometry/velocity/period only. This standalone FV test is a scoped variant; no Firedrake/Clawpack/ExactPack run.
numerical_method: New conservative 2D donor-cell or minmod-MUSCL shared upwind fluxes with SSPRK33. Not Zalesak FCT or LeVeque CTU.
reference: New analytic circle/convex-polygon Green-area integration and disjoint slot partition. Independent SciPy1.14.1 vertical-section adaptive quadrature qualifies12cutcells, wholearea and truefirstmoments. No PDE reference engine.
continuum_solution: Rigid inverse rotation of an indicator; each finite-volume reference is the indicator integral over a cell. Full-turn return alone is supplemented by quarter-turn orientation/trajectory checks.
bounds: Four face-center values average to each P1 mean. Each outgoing face coefficient1/4−dt*outward_speed/h is nonnegative underfaceCourant<=1/4; incoming coefficients are nonnegative and sum withowncoefficients to1 because discretevelocitydivergenceiszero. Minmod bounds facevalues; SSP convexcombinations retainthis conditionalbound.
roundoff: Analytic geometry alone has documented dimensional area and2e−12 fraction cleanup bands, with actual counts/maxima. Numerical evolution retains raw stage values within a separately declared5e−13 roundoff band and performs no state clipping or retries.
boundary_scope: Periodic finite-volume scalar model withmatching normal fluxes and tangential velocity seams. Exact support staysawayfromseams. This is not the official tutorial inflow/outflow problem or a globallysmooth periodic solidrotationfield.
